api-help-title: Step-by-step: creating a Google Books API key
api-help-prereq: A Google account, used to sign in to the Google Cloud Console and manage your keys.
api-help-step1-b: and make sure you are signed in.
api-help-step2-a: In the top bar, open the project selector and choose “New Project”.
api-help-step2-b: Name it, for example Bookaccio, then create it. It takes a few seconds.
api-help-step2-c: Make sure the new project is selected in the top bar.
api-help-step3-b: Search for “Books API” and open the “Google Books API” result.
api-help-step3-c: Click “Enable”. Without this step the key exists but every request is rejected.
api-help-step4-b: Click “+ Create Credentials” and pick “API key”.
api-help-step4-c: Under API restrictions, select “Books API”. Avoid IP or HTTP referrer restrictions: a mobile app cannot satisfy them.
api-help-step4-d: Copy the key straight away — the console will not show it again.
api-help-step5-a: Open Settings > Google Books API Key > Update API Key, paste the key and save.
api-help-quota: Billing is not required: the free quota is ample for personal use.
